title.full: Using MediSave for family hospital bills

summary.text: You can use your MediSave for approved family members if they do not have enough, subject to limits. Speak to the hospital to apply.

details.heading: Who you can help
details.body: Approved dependants refer to a member’s spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. They can be of any nationality except for grandparents and siblings who must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

details.heading: Withdrawal limits
details.body: The amount they can use is subject to the MediSave withdrawal limits, applied per hospitalisation episode. Outstanding expenses after the limit must be paid in cash.

steps.name: Speak to hospital staff
steps.text: Speak to the staff at the hospital's Business Office for more information.

steps.name: Sign the form
steps.text: Approach the hospital where they are receiving treatment at to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF).

sources.page_title: Can I use my MediSave to pay for my family member’s hospitalisation expenses?

quotes.text: If your approved dependants do not have sufficient MediSave for their hospitalisation expenses, you may consider using your MediSave to pay for them.
For more information, please speak to the staff at the hospital's Business Office.

Should you wish to use your MediSave for your approved dependants’ hospitalisation expenses, you may approach the hospital where they are receiving treatment at to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF).

Approved dependants refer to a member’s spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. They can be of any nationality except for grandparents and siblings who must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

the amount they can use is still subject to the MediSave withdrawal limits, which is applied on a per hospitalisation episode basis. If they still have outstanding hospitalisation expenses after using up to the MediSave withdrawal limit, they would have to pay the remainder in cash.
